CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `recette_raw_materials` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `recette_id` int NOT NULL,
  `raw_material_id` int NOT NULL,
  `role` enum('base','coeur','tete','fixateur','modificateur','autre') DEFAULT 'autre',
  `dosage` decimal(8,3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `dosage_unit` varchar(20) DEFAULT 'g',
  `percentage` decimal(5,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `notes` text,
  `sort_order` int DEFAULT 0,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `rrm_unique_link` (`recette_id`,`raw_material_id`),
  KEY `rrm_recette_idx` (`recette_id`),
  KEY `rrm_raw_material_idx` (`raw_material_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
